messages:
priya: Hey — onboarding a customer using Azure AD SAML + SCIM. SCIM provisioning is getting 403s from our /scim/v2/Users endpoint after we rotated the SCIM token last night via KMS. Anyone seen this pattern?
ben: ugh. can you paste the curl + response?
priya: curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" https://api.redwood-inference.internal/scim/v2/Users
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{"detail":"scim:insufficient_scope"}
priya: token was rotated by the rotation job at 02:03 UTC (deploy-bot shows success) but provisioning started failing at ~02:10.
deploy-bot: scim-token-rotate job #2024 succeeded (02:03 UTC) — rotated secret stored in KMS key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01
marta: quick checklist: 1) KMS decrypt OK on the service that serves /scim endpoints? 2) header name / bearer format matches? 3) has the token scope for SCIM push?
kai: also check SAML -> role mapping. If SCIM user lacks the expected group/attribute we treat as insufficient scope in some checks.
priya: looked at service logs (short):
```
2025-04-18T02:09:58Z scim-handler ERROR decrypt:kms failed AccessDeniedException
2025-04-18T02:09:58Z scim-handler WARN fallback: no-token
2025-04-18T02:09:58Z scim-handler INFO request from 52.186.12.34 method=POST path=/scim/v2/Users status=403
```
```
priya: so KMS decrypt failed in the pod that runs scim-api. weird because rotate job wrote the new ciphertext to secrets manager.
ben: check IAM policy on the KMS key for the scim-service-account role — rotation could have created a new ciphertext but if the service role lost decrypt perms it can't use it.
marta: also double-check SCIM token value vs what's in Azure: if Azure still uses old token it would 401 not 403, but our logs show decrypt failure so likely KMS perms.
priya: checking the key policy now, will paste snippet if needed.
ben: while you check, can you confirm RBAC mapping config? our mapping expects `redwood_role` attribute in SAML groups claim. if that is missing we may reject user creation depending on tenant policy. sample mapping in our console config:
```
assertion_mappings:
  groups_claim: groups
  role_attribute: redwood_role
  default_role: viewer
```
ben: but that wouldn't cause KMS decrypt errors. separate issue but helpful to verify customer side.
kai: if decrypt failed due to KMS policy, audit logs should show kms:Decrypt AccessDenied. Check CloudTrail for kms:Decrypt entries around 02:09.
priya: found entries: CloudTrail shows `kms:Decrypt` denied for principal arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/scim-service-role/session. Policy change last modified 2025-04-17T23:50 by infra-admin.
priya: sounds like the policy got tightened during the maintenance window.
ben: yep. action: add `kms:Decrypt` for scim-service-role on that key, redeploy scim-api pod (to pick up env/permission change).
priya: I added the permission and restarted the scim deployment. watching logs...
priya: logs now:
```
2025-04-18T02:12:10Z scim-handler INFO decrypt: success key=abcd-ef01
2025-04-18T02:12:11Z scim-handler INFO provisioning: got SCIM user create payload userName=alice@example.com
2025-04-18T02:12:11Z scim-handler INFO mapping: found redwood_role=editor -> assigning role editor
2025-04-18T02:12:11Z scim-handler INFO request status=201
```
```
marta: nice. do we want an audit entry to track the rotation+failure window for the customer? legal/compliance will ask.
priya: yes — I'll open a compliance ticket with the timeline, CloudTrail snippet, and the KMS policy diff.
kai: also recommend adding an alert: KMS decrypt error rate > 0 for scim-handler -> page on-call. prevents silent provisioning outage.
ben: and a short runbook step: after token rotation, verify service can decrypt new secret before flipping production. maybe a staged rollout of the ciphertext.
priya: agreed. I'll add runbook PR.
ben: closing note — RBAC mapping issue still possible for another tenant: one customer didn't include `redwood_role` claim so we fallback to default viewer; they expected editor. opened issue #412 to add clearer SCIM/SAML onboarding checklist for customers.
priya: thanks all — resolved for this customer. will attach the compliance ticket and PR links in the ticket.
